title: Raku Workshop at Quill Pottery (dates TBA)
source_quote: Raku is coming to Quill! Oh yes! Firing glazed pieces in an outdoor kiln and putting them into a can of paper, organic refuse, and flames... This process creates unique iridescent glazes that will have you hooked and want to come back! If this interests you... subscribe to our newsletter for updates.
evidence_sentence: The home page announces raku firing is coming and invites interested potters to subscribe to the newsletter or contact the studio to get on the list.
summary: Quill Pottery is planning raku firings but has not yet announced dates or registration details; contact the studio or subscribe to the newsletter for updates.
how_to_join: Subscribe to the newsletter or email [email protected] or call 440-518-9992 to be added to the list.
